dict.string: Daily freshness check for the Postgres backup. Lists b2crypt:.../postgres/ and exits nonzero if the newest neondb-*.dump is older than 25 hours. Catches "backups stopped running" within one day. 06:00 local — 2.5h after the 03:30 backup, giving generous slack for slow uploads. RunAtLoad TRUE since 2026-08-20: catches storm-power / reboot scenarios where 06:00 fires during loginwindow-gap. Race guard in wrapper — if pg_backup wrapper is currently running (RunAtLoad pair on same login), canary defers staleness verdict, pings heartbeat, exits 0. Pairs with the weekly restore-test for correctness coverage.
